description: Source code for the client component of the Emergency Access Daemon, implementing network communication, authentication, and command execution.

methods.name: set_nonblock
methods.description: Sets the socket to non-blocking mode based on the enable parameter.

methods.name: send_packet
methods.description: Sends a network packet and processes responses with a handler callback, up to a maximum number of responses.

methods.name: prepare_password
methods.description: Prepares the password for authentication, applying MD5 hashing if configured.

methods.name: handle_pong
methods.description: Handles pong responses from the server, updating authentication state.

methods.name: handle_prime
methods.description: Handles prime/salt messages from the server, initializing cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: handle_b
methods.description: Handles number messages from the server, storing data in buffer B.

methods.name: handle_cmd_data
methods.description: Handles command data messages, decrypting and outputting data.

methods.name: send_ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message to the server.

methods.name: send_a
methods.description: Sends the client's public key component A.

methods.name: send_command
methods.description: Sends a command to the server for execution.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.
